an9.7:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati gijjhakūṭe pabbate.
an9.7:1.2: athakho sutavā paribbājako yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi
an9.7:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho sutavā paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an9.7:2.1: ekamidāhaṃ bhante samayaṃ bhagavā idheva rājagahe viharāmi giribbaje
an9.7:2.2: tatra kho me bhante bhagavato sammukhā sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ
an9.7:2.3: yo so sutava bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaññojano sammadaññāvimutto abhabbo so pañcaṭṭhānāni ajjhācarituṃ
an9.7:2.4: abhabbo khīṇāsavo bhikkhu sañcicca pāṇaṃ jīvitā voropetuṃ abhabbo khīṇāsavo bhikkhu adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādātuṃ abhabbo khīṇāsavo bhikkhu methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevituṃ abhabbo khīṇāsavo bhikkhu sampajānamusā bhāsituṃ abhabbo khīṇāsavo bhikkhu sannidhikārakaṃ kāme paribhuñjituṃ seyyathāpi pubbe agāriyabhūto
an9.7:2.5: kacci metaṃ bhante bhagavato sussutaṃ suggahitaṃ sumanasikataṃ sūpadhāritanti.
an9.7:3.1: taggha te etaṃ sussutaṃ suggahitaṃ sumanasikataṃ sūpadhāritaṃ
an9.7:3.2: pubbe cāhaṃ sutava etarahi ca evaṃ vadāmi
an9.7:3.3: yo so bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaññojano sammadaññāvimutto abhabbo so navaṭṭhānāni ajjhācarituṃ
an9.7:3.4: abhabbo khīṇāsavo bhikkhu sañcicca pāṇaṃ jīvitā voropetuṃ abhabbo khīṇāsavo bhikkhu adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādātuṃ abhabbo khīṇāsavo bhikkhu methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevituṃ abhabbo khīṇāsavo bhikkhu sampajānamusā bhāsituṃ abhabbo khīṇāsavo bhikkhu sannidhikārakaṃ kāme paribhuñjituṃ seyyathāpi pubbe agāriyabhūto abhabbo khīṇāsavo bhikkhu chandāgatiṃ gantuṃ abhabbo khīṇāsavo bhikkhu dosāgatiṃ gantuṃ abhabbo khīṇāsavo bhikkhu mohāgatiṃ gantuṃ abhabbo khīṇāsavo bhikkhu bhayāgatiṃ gantuṃ
an9.7:3.5: pubbe cāhaṃ sutava etarahi ca evaṃ vadāmi
an9.7:3.6: yo so bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaññojano sammadaññāvimutto abhabbo so imāni navaṭṭhānāni ajjhācaritunti. 8
